# Unusual game windows, fix/window141: run it once at each size, on the branch and with -f mod_ref=main for the old code.
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=fix/window141 -f script=.github/checks/window141.txt -f size=800x1000
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=main -f script=.github/checks/window141.txt -f size=800x1000
# Sizes: 800x1000 (tall), 640x480 (the smallest GUI, 320x240), 3440x1440 and 2560x1080 (ultrawide), 3840x2160 (4K).
# GUI scale Auto (guiscale 0) gives: 800x1000 -> 2 (400x500), 640x480 -> 2 (320x240), 3440x1440 -> 6 (574x240),
# 2560x1080 -> 4 (640x270), 3840x2160 -> 9 (427x240). Minecraft never goes below 320x240: asking 1280x720 for GUI scale 4
# gives 3 (426x240). The "-g2" shots are GUI scale 2 (3440x1440 -> 1720x720, 3840x2160 -> 1920x1080), "-g1" scale 1.
#
# 1. Top bar, top and bottom, with the clock and the frame rate: w141-bar-top-auto, w141-bar-bottom-auto, w141-bar-top-g2,
#    w141-bar-top-g1, and a long made-up title as the song changes: w141-bar-title-auto (cut with "..."). The pill is
#    never wider than 270 GUI units (at GUI scale 2 on 3440 wide that is 540 of 3440 pixels: a short bar in the middle,
#    not stretched); on 640x480 it fits between the clock and the frame rate. The
#    sung word's highlight sits on the word, the cover (or the note) is round, the text is cut before the equaliser.
#    The bottom bar sits above the hotbar's hearts (creative: no hearts, 50 up), never over the hotbar.
# 2. Record card with three lines in each corner (w141-card-tl, -tr, -bl, -br), and the top bar on: whole on the
#    screen, its title and artist cut with "...", the bottom ones above the hotbar (on 640x480 lifted above it).
# 3. Arc and Lines layouts: w141-arc, w141-lines (Auto) and w141-lines-g2: the lines inside the screen's width (they
#    already wrap to the window's shape).
# 4. Settings (Look tab and Display tab) at Auto, GUI scale 2 and 1: w141-settings-look-auto, -display-auto,
#    -display-g2, -display-g1, then a search with a long description's tooltip: w141-settings-tip-auto/-g2. The panel
#    is at most 440x272 GUI units, so at GUI scale 1 on 3440x1440 or 3840x2160 it is a small box in the middle (a
#    design question, not a bug); rows never run past the panel, the tooltip stays on the screen.
# 5. Song library (the demo's made-up songs): w141-lib-grid-auto, -shelf-auto, -carousel-auto, then -grid-g2 and
#    -grid-g1: at most 460x300 GUI units; the grid's columns fill the panel's width, covers and names are not cut off.
# 6. World words (last: the made-up lines replace the demo song's), looking level (look 0 0) at a long made-up line
#    sung over 4 seconds: w141-world-a/-b/-c (the scatter, the default) and w141-flow-a/-b/-c (Flowing line on), Keep
#    the middle clear on, then w141-flow-nomid-a/-b/-c with Keep the middle clear off. Where the test world puts a sand
#    wall or hill beside you, words with no clear place in front of it were lifted up its side; since fix/flow143 they
#    stop under the top of the screen (a flowing line's: under where its rows go, floating up counted) and never land
#    on another word, else they keep their place drawn through the sand (flow143.txt builds such a wall on purpose).
#    Old code at 800x1000 (and less so 640x480): words at the left and right are cut by the screen's edge or missing,
#      a flowing line's rows run off one side (they were spread up to 40 degrees out, the screen shows 29).
#    Branch: every word whole on the screen, a little in from each edge. 3440x1440, 2560x1080, 3840x2160: the same
#      pictures on both (the branch changes nothing on a wide screen).

cmd weather clear
cmd time set noon
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
set layout LINES
set worldFlow false
set worldClearMiddle true
guiscale 0
look 0 -20
sleep 8

# 1. Top bar, paused on "Every word is written in the stars"
music pause
sleep 1
seek 26
sleep 3
shot w141-bar-top-auto
set barPosition BOTTOM
sleep 2
shot w141-bar-bottom-auto
set barPosition TOP
guiscale 2
sleep 2
shot w141-bar-top-g2
guiscale 1
sleep 2
shot w141-bar-top-g1
guiscale 0
song A Very Long Made Up Song Title That Keeps Going Past The Bar | Mira Vale, The Glass Tide Orchestra & Friends
sleep 1
shot w141-bar-title-auto
song Neon Skyline | SkyLyrics Demo
sleep 5

# 2. Record card, three lines, each corner
set recordCard true
set cardLines 3
set cardCorner TOP_LEFT
sleep 2
shot w141-card-tl
set cardCorner TOP_RIGHT
sleep 2
shot w141-card-tr
set cardCorner BOTTOM_LEFT
sleep 2
shot w141-card-bl
set cardCorner BOTTOM_RIGHT
sleep 2
shot w141-card-br
set recordCard false
music play

# 3. Arc and Lines
set layout ARC
seek 20
sleep 5
shot w141-arc
set layout LINES
seek 20
sleep 5
shot w141-lines
guiscale 2
sleep 2
shot w141-lines-g2
guiscale 0
sleep 1

# 4. Settings
gui 1
sleep 3
shot w141-settings-look-auto
gui 3
sleep 3
shot w141-settings-display-auto
guiscale 2
sleep 2
shot w141-settings-display-g2
guiscale 1
sleep 2
shot w141-settings-display-g1
guiscale 0
sleep 2
search underground
sleep 2
shot w141-settings-tip-auto
guiscale 2
sleep 2
shot w141-settings-tip-g2
guiscale 0
close
sleep 1

# 5. Song library
set libraryView GRID
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
shot w141-lib-grid-auto
close
set libraryView SHELF
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
shot w141-lib-shelf-auto
close
set libraryView CAROUSEL
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
shot w141-lib-carousel-auto
close
set libraryView GRID
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
guiscale 2
sleep 3
shot w141-lib-grid-g2
guiscale 1
sleep 3
shot w141-lib-grid-g1
guiscale 0
close
sleep 1

# 6. World words: a long made-up line, one every 4 seconds, looking level
set layout WORLD
look 0 0
lines lanterns drift over the harbour while the slow tide carries every little light away into the morning | quiet engines hum beneath the bridges as the city counts its windows one by one | paper boats remember every river that they never sailed upon
seek 0
sleep 2.5
shot w141-world-a
sleep 2
shot w141-world-b
sleep 3
shot w141-world-c
set worldFlow true
seek 0
sleep 2.5
shot w141-flow-a
sleep 2
shot w141-flow-b
sleep 3
shot w141-flow-c
set worldClearMiddle false
seek 0
sleep 2.5
shot w141-flow-nomid-a
sleep 2
shot w141-flow-nomid-b
sleep 3
shot w141-flow-nomid-c
set worldClearMiddle true
set worldFlow false
